title: Zun'Muram Volklana
summary: Volklana begins rooted, casting terror until his health falls far enough.
overview: Volklana begins rooted, casting terror until his health falls far enough.

abilities.name: Zun'Muram's Terror
abilities.summary: Repeated casts affect clients within 120 units during the rooted opening.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for immediate Terror and further casts every five seconds while the boss remains above 85%.
At 85%, the terror timer stops and Volklana becomes mobile.
Have the tank ready to reposition for the mobile fight.
If his health recovers to 87%, he returns to his initial rooted position.
